summary: A large Doha brokerage appears to lose valuation leads to a missing form, dead menu items and filler content.

findings.problem: Book your free valuation appears to send visitors to another page, with no valuation form on this page.
findings.cost: Owners ready to sell face an extra step.

findings.problem: The About menu item and a download confirmation link appear to link to #.
Typos such as across the Qatar and Over250k appear, and trending search lists appear to repeat Apartments for Sale in Doha dozens of times, including Spain and Oman.
findings.cost: Repeated filler and typos look automated and careless.
findings.fix: Clean copy and relevant search links.

findings.problem: More than 2,500 clients have rated us 5 stars appears with no reviews shown, and the newsletter block appears to show no input field.
findings.cost: Unsupported claims and broken forms reduce trust.
findings.fix: Real reviews and a working signup form.
